Okay, so we are still looking for one counselor to sit on this board of revision for 2027. And I guess uh the option is out there if we this is an election year, so it's it's it's really presumptive uh who's going to be here at the at the election there. Um or we could defer it till October uh uh It's up. You good to step up then, Glenn? Okay. Be it resolved that the RM of Springfield 2027 Board of Revision be held November 12th, 2026. And be it further resolved that the board be composed of the following people. That is unanimous, so carried. Um I I think uh I'll throw it out there because I'm I'm not running again there, but I think uh council, the next council coming in should should seriously think uh well it's not, it's the option is there to have citizens on there. Uh so I think uh that that could be explored, but that'll be up to uh to next council. That's just my my my thought on that. We'll go to 10.2, that's ward appropriations, please. Can I get a mover or a second for that? Uh Miller and uh Warren. Okay, so we have received a request for support from Tristan Fandich for soccer championships out in Newfoundland. Everybody uh read that about uh Tristan there. Um what's uh uh council's uh thoughts on that? Counselor Miller. Uh thank you, Mr. Mayor. I'd dedicate the rest of my uh appropriation to that. I think it's $110 that I have, yeah. So, I'm happy to do that. Okay. Other counselors at all? Everybody's at 110. I think I'm the richest guy in the table. I think I got 694 left. 150? Okay. That won't be part of the condition, but if Tristan's uh listening, uh he's able to do something like that, uh we wouldn't object to that at all. Okay. Be it resolved that the following 2026 ward appropriations be approved. Tristan Fandich, Wards 2, 3, 4 and Mayor 110 each. Ward 1, $150. All right, with that uh being explained, uh I'll pose the question for those in support. That is unanimous and so carried. Be it resolved that all of council be delegated to attend the Manitoba Association of Regional Recyclers Forum on October 14th and 15th in Winnipeg at their discretion. Thank you. meetings.summary: The RM of Springfield Council meeting on September 15, 2026, commenced at 6:00 p.m. The agenda and previous meeting minutes were unanimously approved. A key agenda item concerning a Bell MTS tower was deferred to October 6th. The council appointed members to the 2027 Board of Revision, including Counselor Melinda Warren and Counselor Glenn Fuel. Ward appropriations were approved to support Tristan Fandich's participation in soccer championships. Additionally, council members were delegated to attend the Manitoba Association of Regional Recyclers Forum and the AMM Fall Convention. The meeting concluded and adjourned at 6:10 p.m., with council members requested to remain for a post-meeting assessment discussion.
key_points: Item 8.1, regarding a Bell MTS tower near Lindcrest Airport, was deferred to October 6th.
The 2027 Board of Revision will be held on November 12, 2026, with Doug Shaver as Chair, Counselor Melinda Warren, Counselor Glenn Fuel, and Christy Gronhide as Board Secretary.
Ward appropriations were approved to support Tristan Fandich for soccer championships in Newfoundland.
Council members were delegated to attend the Manitoba Association of Regional Recyclers Forum on October 14th and 15th in Winnipeg.
Council members were delegated to attend the AMM Fall Convention and pre-convention seminar in Brandon from November 23rd to 26th.
The Mayor suggested that the next council consider the option of appointing citizens to the Board of Revision.
Darian Vasas was congratulated for a successful trial rugby event.
The East Man Regional Municipal Committee discussed small modular reactors and seniors housing.
decisions: The meeting agenda for September 15, 2026, was approved unanimously.
The minutes from September 1, 2026, were adopted unanimously.
The consent agenda (items 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4) was approved unanimously.

The RM of Springfield 2027 Board of Revision will be held November 12, 2026, and be composed of Doug Shaver (Chair), Counselor Melinda Warren, Counselor Glenn Fuel, and Christy Gronhide (Board Secretary). This was approved unanimously.
The 2026 ward appropriations were approved for Tristan Fandich, with Wards 2, 3, 4, and the Mayor contributing $110 each, and Ward 1 contributing $150. This was approved unanimously.
All of council was delegated to attend the Manitoba Association of Regional Recyclers Forum on October 14th and 15th in Winnipeg at their discretion. This was approved unanimously.
All of council was delegated to attend the AMM Fall Convention and pre-convention seminar in Brandon from November 23rd to 26th at their discretion. This was approved unanimously.
The meeting was adjourned unanimously at 6:10 p.m.
